issues.description: The template defines a class named AnimalFarm (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) while the problem statement, UML, and the solution expect a class named Farm. Main.java (problem template) also refers to Farm. This mismatch will prevent students from finding/implementing the expected Farm class and will cause compilation errors.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template class AnimalFarm to Farm and correct its contents to match the specification (provide the animals List, constructor initializing the ArrayList, getter/setter, addAnimal, feedAllAnimals, singFarmSong, and private singFarmSongVerse). Also remove any malformed/duplicated package declarations present inside the file so that the class compiles and maps clearly to the UML and Main.java usage.
